items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: And of course it’s grown like topsy, it’s fantastic what she’s done, and all the superstars of the cooking world come here to teach, which to me is the greatest accolade, because that’s for her really that they come. You know, Pepin, everybody comes here.

ctx.x: She carries the brain factory. I carry the travel factory. No I was in the racecar business at one time and one of our dear friends was a Grand Prix driver, as many of them, was killed. And his wife and Ruth started a little shop here. And then Louise decided this wasn’t a life for her so Ruth took it over and that was 25 years ago. And of course it’s grown like topsy, it’s fantastic what she’s done, and all the superstars of the cooking world come here to teach, which to me is the greatest accolade, because…
You have an affinity for tractors also.
